verses.text: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah. O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.

xrefs.text: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah
My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”

verses.text: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.

xrefs.text: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.
Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.

verses.text: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.

xrefs.text: I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.
Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.

verses.text: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.

xrefs.text: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly of Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven,
A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.

verses.text: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.

xrefs.text: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare a lavish banquet for all the peoples, a feast of aged wine, of choice meat, of finely aged wine.
As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.
Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.

verses.text: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.

xrefs.text: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
Let the saints exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.
In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.
You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.

verses.text: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.

xrefs.text: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and He will deliver us. In Him we have placed our hope that He will yet again deliver us,
Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings

For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.

verses.text: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.

xrefs.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.
Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
His left hand is under my head, and his right arm embraces me.
Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.

verses.text: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.

xrefs.text: Let death seize them by surprise; let them go down to Sheol alive, for evil is with them in their homes.
The wicked will return to Sheol— all the nations who forget God.
May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.

And should someone pursue you and seek your life, then the life of my lord will be bound securely by the LORD your God in the bundle of the living. But He shall fling away the lives of your enemies like stones from a sling.
For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.

verses.text: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.

xrefs.text: Therefore, hand their children over to famine; pour out the power of the sword upon them. Let their wives become childless and widowed; let their husbands be slain by disease, their young men struck down by the sword in battle.
Because you harbored an ancient hatred and delivered the Israelites over to the sword in the time of their disaster at the final stage of their punishment,
On the mountains of Israel you will fall— you and all your troops and the nations with you. I will give you as food to every kind of ravenous bird and wild beast.
David added, “As surely as the LORD lives, the LORD Himself will strike him down; either his day will come and he will die, or he will go into battle and perish.

And as for you, son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: Call out to every kind of bird and to every beast of the field: ‘Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you, a great feast on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood.

verses.text: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.

xrefs.text: Fear the LORD your God, serve Him only, and take your oaths in His name.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.
By Myself I have sworn; truth has gone out from My mouth, a word that will not be revoked: Every knee will bow before Me, every tongue will swear allegiance.

Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the God of truth, and whoever takes an oath in the land will swear by the God of truth. For the former troubles will be forgotten and hidden from My sight.
